race.comment: SCOOPED (2) has been knocking on the door throughout this prep and the form around him is solid. Doesn't need to improve much her to get the job done. SUPER WONDER (9) was well supported fresh but just missed the bob at Murray Bridge. Should've come on from that and is drawn to get all the favours. Obvious danger. JUST COMET (6) hit the line hard when resuming at Murray Bridge to grab second. Better for the hitout and if the tempo is genuine she's a chance to pounce on them late. BILK (4) didn't live up to market expectation in his debut prep but looks to have come back in good order, fitted with two jumpouts. The 3kg claimer sticks and should know him quite well by now. OLIVIA MARIE  (7) never gave in first-up and is another likely improver. Can fill a spot.
